# Heatmap

A grid of cells shaded by count on one sequential ramp, from surface-2 (none) to brand lavender (most): key × energy coverage of the library, and a plays-by-da…

`SongNodes.Heatmap` · Charts

## Use

```jsx
<SongNodes.Heatmap title="…" subtitle="…" rows={…} />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="SongNodes.Heatmap" title="…" subtitle="…" rows="{{…}}"></x-import>
```

## Props (HeatmapProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `lead` | `string` | Title lead and title ("Key & mood", "Library coverage"). |
| `title` * | `string` |  |
| `subtitle` * | `string` |  |
| `rows` * | `Array<{ label: string; ariaLabel?: string; camelot?: string }>` | Row headers; `camelot` adds the key dot ("8A"). |
| `columns` * | `Array<{ label: string; ariaLabel?: string }>` | Column headers; empty label keeps the column unlabelled visually. |
| `gapsAfter` | `number[]` | Column indexes after which a 4px gap is drawn (energy tiers: [3, 6]). |
| `values` * | `Array<Array<number \| null \| "future">>` | Counts [row][col]; null = no data (dashed), "future" = blank. |
| `bins` | `number[]` | Lower bounds of ramp steps 0–6; default [0, 1, 4, 8, 13, 19, 26]. |
| `noDataLabel` | `string` | Words for the no-data key ("No episode"). |
| `cell` | `{ width: number; height: number }` | Cell size in px. |
| `describe` * | `(row: number, col: number, value: number \| null \| "future") => string` | Readout and aria text for a cell. |
| `onCellSelect` | `(row: number, col: number) => void` | Called when a cell is activated with Enter or click. |
